description: This source file defines the `TalkModeManager` class, which centralizes talk mode state and behavior for an iOS application. It handles speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, chat interaction, and incremental speech streaming. The class manages microphone permissions, audio sessions, recognition tasks, TTS requests (including integration with ElevenLabs API), and chat session handling. It also includes complex logic for managing push-to-talk functionality, silence detection, incremental speech, and error recovery.
